# Trader AI

> AI-assisted market research, chart analysis, strategy building, backtesting, paper trading and risk management tools for traders. Trader AI is a research and analysis platform only — it does not execute trades, manage funds, or provide regulated financial advice.

## Getting Started

- [Home](https://thetraderai.net/): Platform overview.
- [Register](https://thetraderai.net/register/): Create a free account.

## Tools

- [AI Trading Platform](https://thetraderai.net/ai-trading-platform/): Full platform overview.
- [AI Chart Analyser](https://thetraderai.net/tools/ai-chart-analyser/): Upload a chart and receive structured AI analysis.
- [AI Trading Assistant](https://thetraderai.net/ai-trading-assistant/): Ask market questions in plain English.
- [AI Strategy Builder](https://thetraderai.net/ai-strategy-builder/): Describe a strategy and generate rule-based logic.
- [Strategy Backtesting](https://thetraderai.net/backtesting/): Test strategies against historical data.
- [Paper Trading](https://thetraderai.net/paper-trading/): Practise in a simulated environment.
- [Risk Management](https://thetraderai.net/risk-management/): Define risk before considering a trade.
- [AI Trading Signals](https://thetraderai.net/ai-trading-signals/): Signals with context and clear data labelling.

## AI Traders

- [AI Trader Leaderboard](https://thetraderai.net/ai-trader-leaderboard/): Compare AI traders across risk and return dimensions.
- [AI Traders Directory](https://thetraderai.net/ai-traders/): Profiles of available AI traders.
